_comment: ShopCardHub Pokémon DEMAND LIST — the ~270 English Pokémon cards collectors most often look for, built 2026-10-04 by the Coverage Scout for tools/kb/coverage-scan.mjs. 'why' = angle(s) that put the card here: value (PriceCharting ungraded ≥ ~$400 or top of its set), pop (top of PriceCharting's per-set Popularity sort, or a PSA most-graded list), search (Google autocomplete for the card name returns its set/number/edition), landmark (KB 01 §5 / record cards), chase (top-3 cards of a 2016–2026 main set). Prices: PriceCharting console pages fetched 2026-10-04 (rawUSD = ungraded, psa10USD = PSA 10 column) — a sanity check, never a site price; PC vintage PSA 10s are unreliable (KB README #18). conf: MED = one reputable source (PriceCharting) per KB tags. scope 'jp' entries are flagged and never expected on the site. Refresh quarterly by a research pass; never invent a pcPath. 'rarity' is a heuristic label [LOW] except on chase-index sets, where it is read from data/indices.json.
